rows.label: Heart of Deimos, then The New War
Whispers in the Walls
rows.note: unlocks Sanctum Anatomica and Albrecht's Laboratories

conditions: Completing the quest unlocks Sanctum Anatomica, the Cavia syndicate, and Albrecht's Laboratories.
Parts never drop from the bounty reward itself, only from Albrecht's Laboratories endless mission rotations.
Bird 3 sells Qorvex parts for Cavia standing but does not sell anything Mandonel.
You get one bounty reward regardless of how long you stay past the objective, so rush and leave for the blueprint roll alone.
bonuses: It shares the table with Qorvex Neuroptics, Shrill Voca, Aya, credits and Endo, so a spare Mandonel blueprint is common if you're also farming Qorvex.
The blueprint is tradable, so spares from repeated runs are easy to offload or acquire.
A Survival-type bounty run to 20 minutes also rolls the Albrecht's Laboratories Persto rotation rewards in the same run — the two grinds combine.

disclosures.title: skip the low tier
disclosures.body: The 65-70 tier's blueprint chance (3.39%) is noticeably lower than the other four tiers per the wiki's drop tables, not Reddit advice. The wiki also doesn't show whether any tier needs a Cavia rank, so check in game.

rows.label: Mandonel Stock
rows.note: Persto B 17.5%, Munio C 15%, Cambire C 16%

conditions: Munio Mirror Defense runs AABC; the fourth round is the first C, so leaving after three rounds wastes the C roll.

The community widely calls Munio miserable (it shares the Tome Mods grind); Persto Survival is the best part farm by these numbers since one 20-minute run covers Barrel and Receiver at C and Stock at B.
bonuses: Search for Echo Voca medallions while running these missions with Loot Detector, Thief's Wit, Animal Instinct or Golden Instinct — they make a low sound and are needed for the build.

disclosures.title: the return to rotation C
disclosures.body: Launch-era community reaction to needing AABC rotation-C farming for these parts was strongly negative; a highly upvoted post called it a serious regression and said they'd skip Mandonel over it. One OP ran 100+ bounties with nothing, then got the blueprint and two Qorvex sets in about 20 runs — that spread is real.

conditions: Qorvex, Grimoire and the Helminth Coalescent Segment all compete for the same Echo Voca supply, so buy it from Loid whenever it's up.
